property_summary: After a successful 10-ether fallback call at timestamp t1 (no payout) that sets pastBlockTime = t1, any second 10-ether call at t2 <= t1 in a payout block must revert, leaving c's balance unchanged at 20 ether; the mutant never records t1, so the second call succeeds and pays out the balance, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Delete the statement 'pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;' so the recorded timestamp never updates, allowing subsequent calls to pass the time check immediately.
